If you're a nuclear engineering student, Dr. Kimber is a must have!

Thermodynamics is a hard class, but Dr. Kimber taught this class very well. We had daily quizzes each lecture. His expectations of his students are high, but he is very caring about each of his students. If you are a NUEN major, I recommend taking this class instead of the MEEN version. He gave practice examples and was accessible outside of class.

Dr. Kimber is a fantastic professor. He has high expectations for his students, so make sure to stay on top of your work if you take his class. I really appreciated that his lecture content and provided examples always had practical applications that were clear and well-defined. Highly recommend taking his class!!

Kimber is an outstanding professor. He does a great job showing the big picture as well as why things work the ways they do. He seems to have a natural ability to make complicated things simple and approachable. Highly recommended for any course at any level.
